botswana/maun-gateway.name: Maun, gateway to the Okavango
botswana/maun-gateway.description: A dusty safari hub with airstrips, craft shops and last-minute supplies.
botswana/maun-gateway.details: Maun is the starting point for most trips into the Okavango Delta, with the airport, charter flights and safari outfitters. There is little to see in town, though a river walk, a craft market and a cafe stop make a pleasant first evening. Check luggage rules for light aircraft, as soft bags with weight limits are required.

botswana/delta-scenic-flight.name: Okavango Delta scenic flight
botswana/delta-scenic-flight.description: A light-aircraft flight over channels, islands and elephant herds in the world largest inland delta.
botswana/delta-scenic-flight.details: The flight from Maun to a camp is a highlight in itself, with the Delta spread below in channels, lagoons and palm islands, often with elephants, hippos and buffalo visible. A dedicated scenic flight of about an hour can be added. Weight limits for luggage apply, and seats are limited.

botswana/mokoro-delta.name: Mokoro and walking safari in the Delta
botswana/mokoro-delta.description: A silent glide through reed channels in a dugout canoe, with guided walks on the islands.
botswana/mokoro-delta.details: A poler stands at the back of the mokoro and moves through the lily-covered channels, giving an up-close view of birds, frogs and the odd hippo from water level. Guided bush walks on the islands reveal the smaller wildlife and tracks. The best months are June to October, when the flood waters peak.

botswana/delta-game-drive.name: Delta island game drive and night drive
botswana/delta-game-drive.description: Open-vehicle drives on the Delta islands, including after dark in some camps.
botswana/delta-game-drive.details: Camps on larger islands offer game drives for lions, leopards, wild dogs and plains game. Night drives are possible in some private concessions, but not in national parks. Drives start at dawn and late afternoon, when animals are most active.

botswana/moremi-game-drive.name: Moremi Game Reserve game drives
botswana/moremi-game-drive.description: Some of the best wildlife viewing in Africa, with lions, wild dogs, leopards and elephants in a mosaic of floodplains and woodland.
botswana/moremi-game-drive.details: Moremi covers the eastern side of the Delta and is known for predators. Morning and afternoon drives in an open vehicle with a guide cover the lagoons at Third Bridge and Xakanaxa. The dry season from June to October is best for game concentrated around water, while the green season brings birds and young animals.

botswana/xakanaxa-boat.name: Xakanaxa boat safari
botswana/xakanaxa-boat.description: A boat trip through lagoons and papyrus channels with hippos, crocodiles and a huge variety of birds.
botswana/xakanaxa-boat.details: The Xakanaxa lagoon is a birder paradise, with African skimmers, fish eagles and herons. A boat trip on the Khwai river and lagoon is a quiet way to view elephants drinking at the water. It is usually a morning or afternoon activity.

botswana/savute-drive.name: Savute Channel and lion country
botswana/savute-drive.description: A dry channel that sometimes flows, drawing lions, hyenas and elephants in Chobe National Park.
botswana/savute-drive.details: Savute is known for its predators, including lion prides that hunt elephants and zebra, and ancient San rock paintings at Gubatsa Hills. The marsh and channel attract game in the dry season. The roads are sandy, so drives are with a guide in a 4x4. Remote camps give a wild atmosphere.

botswana/chobe-river-cruise.name: Chobe River boat cruise
botswana/chobe-river-cruise.description: A boat trip along the river border with Namibia, with large herds of elephants, buffalo and hippos.
botswana/chobe-river-cruise.details: The Chobe River floodplain holds one of the largest elephant populations in Africa, and in the dry season herds come to drink and swim. Boat cruises put you at water level, with crocodiles, hippos and many birds. Sunset cruises are the most atmospheric.

botswana/chobe-game-drive.name: Chobe riverfront game drive
botswana/chobe-game-drive.description: A game drive along the river road of Chobe National Park, home to elephants, lions and giraffe.
botswana/chobe-game-drive.details: Chobe National Park has a riverfront with huge numbers of elephants, plus lions, buffalo and sable antelope. Drives leave from Kasane at dawn, and the dry season is best. Combine with a river cruise for different perspectives. Entry to the park is paid per vehicle.

botswana/kasane-village.name: Kasane and village visit
botswana/kasane-village.description: The town on the Chobe River, with a craft market and cultural visit.
botswana/kasane-village.details: Kasane is the base for Chobe and is close to the borders of Namibia, Zambia and Zimbabwe. Cultural tours take in a local village, a market and a school. A day trip to Victoria Falls on the Zimbabwe side is a popular extra, with a cross-border transfer.

botswana.name: Botswana
botswana.description: A safari country of the Okavango Delta, Chobe elephants and wild Kalahari landscapes.

botswana/maun.name: Maun
botswana/maun.description: The safari gateway on the edge of the Okavango Delta.

botswana/okavango-delta.name: Okavango Delta
botswana/okavango-delta.description: A vast inland delta of channels and islands, best explored by mokoro and walking safari.

botswana/moremi-game-reserve.name: Moremi Game Reserve
botswana/moremi-game-reserve.description: A reserve on the eastern Delta known for lions, wild dogs and leopards.

botswana/savute.name: Savute
botswana/savute.description: A remote part of Chobe National Park famed for its predators.

botswana/kasane.name: Kasane
botswana/kasane.description: The gateway to Chobe and its river full of elephants.

botswana/chobe.name: Chobe National Park
botswana/chobe.description: Botswana elephant stronghold on the river border with Namibia.
